package main
const Text = "a" + "b"
const TypedText string = "a"
const Joined = TypedText + "b"
const Compare = 1 < 2
const Logic = true && false
const TypedBool bool = true
const Mixed = TypedBool || false
const Negated = !true
const TypedNegated = !TypedBool
const Shifted = 1 << 2
const Minimum = min("b", "a")
const TypedMinimum = min(TypedText, "b")
var Compared = 1 != 2
var Combined = "a" + "b"
func Probe(s string, n int, flag bool, buf []byte) {
 index := len(s) - 1
 total := n + 2 * 3
 shifted := 1 << n
 less := n < total
 logical := flag && true
 negated := !flag
 text := s + "x"
 low := min(n, 2)
 high := max(s, "b")
 copied := copy(buf, []byte{})
 capacity := cap(buf)
 realPart := real(1 + 2i)
 imaginaryPart := imag(1 + 2i)
 z := complex(1, 2)
 _ = index; _ = total; _ = shifted; _ = less; _ = logical
 _ = negated; _ = text; _ = low; _ = high; _ = copied
 _ = capacity; _ = realPart; _ = imaginaryPart; _ = z
 { len := func(s string) string { return s }; var explicit string = len(s); _ = explicit }
}
